title: Grammar Checker — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Identifies grammar, punctuation, and spelling errors with explanations. The Grammar Checker identifies grammar, punctuation, and spelling errors in student writing. It scans each sentence, flags problems with a plain explanation of the rule broken, and suggests a correction the student can accept or reject. It handles subject-verb agreement, tense consistency, comma use, apostrophes, and common spelling mistakes.
capabilities: Flag grammar errors with plain rule explanations
Check punctuation: commas, apostrophes, colons
Catch spelling mistakes and commonly confused words
Verify subject-verb agreement and tense consistency
Suggest corrections the writer accepts or rejects

demo.title: Advanced pattern: readability metrics
demo.code: const text='Clear writing helps readers. Short sentences work well. Vary the length for flow.';const words=text.split(/\s+/).length;const sents=text.split('.').filter(s=>s.trim()).length;const avg=+(words/sents).toFixed(1);J({words,sentences:sents,avgWordsPerSentence:avg});assert(words===13&&sents===3&&avg===4.3,'readability');
